name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Raspberry Rose Mickey Macaron (Whole Raspberry Seed Warning!)
brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Reference warning: the center of the famous Raspberry Rose Mickey Macaron is packed with whole fresh raspberries containing hundreds of hard insoluble seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If tasting in remission, eat only the outer almond-flour macaron shell and rose buttercream ring while leaving the whole raspberries in the center—or order the Alien Macarooooon (salted caramel) in Tomorrowland instead!
watchOuts: Center is filled with whole raspberries (insoluble berry seeds) plus almond flour shell
